From 91b623cda43e449a49177ba99b6723f551a4bfbe Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Thomas=20Wei=C3=9Fschuh?= <linux@weissschuh.net>
Date: Fri, 29 Mar 2024 09:18:29 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] power: supply: core: simplify charge_behaviour formatting
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The function power_supply_show_charge_behaviour() is not needed and can
be removed completely.
Removing the function also saves a spurious read of the property from
the driver on each call.

The convulted logic was a leftover from an earlier patch revision.
Some restructuring made this cleanup possible.

Suggested-by: Hans de Goede <hdegoede@redhat.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/all/9e035ae4-cb07-4f84-8336-1a0050855bea@redhat.com/
Fixes: 4e61f1e9d58f ("power: supply: core: fix charge_behaviour formatting")
Signed-off-by: Thomas Weißschuh <linux@weissschuh.net>
Reviewed-by: Hans de Goede <hdegoede@redhat.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240329-power-supply-simplify-v1-1-416f1002739f@weissschuh.net
Signed-off-by: Sebastian Reichel <sebastian.reichel@collabora.com>

diff --git a/drivers/power/supply/power_supply_sysfs.c b/drivers/power/supply/power_supply_sysfs.c
index 0d2c3724d0bc..b86e11bdc07e 100644
--- a/drivers/power/supply/power_supply_sysfs.c
+++ b/drivers/power/supply/power_supply_sysfs.c
@@ -271,23 +271,6 @@ static ssize_t power_supply_show_usb_type(struct device *dev,
 	return count;
 }
 
-static ssize_t power_supply_show_charge_behaviour(struct device *dev,
-						  struct power_supply *psy,
-						  union power_supply_propval *value,
-						  char *buf)
-{
-	int ret;
-
-	ret = power_supply_get_property(psy,
-					POWER_SUPPLY_PROP_CHARGE_BEHAVIOUR,
-					value);
-	if (ret < 0)
-		return ret;
-
-	return power_supply_charge_behaviour_show(dev, psy->desc->charge_behaviours,
-						  value->intval, buf);
-}
-
 static ssize_t power_supply_show_property(struct device *dev,
 					  struct device_attribute *attr,
 					  char *buf) {
@@ -321,7 +304,8 @@ static ssize_t power_supply_show_property(struct device *dev,
 						&value, buf);
 		break;
 	case POWER_SUPPLY_PROP_CHARGE_BEHAVIOUR:
-		ret = power_supply_show_charge_behaviour(dev, psy, &value, buf);
+		ret = power_supply_charge_behaviour_show(dev, psy->desc->charge_behaviours,
+							 value.intval, buf);
 		break;
 	case POWER_SUPPLY_PROP_MODEL_NAME ... POWER_SUPPLY_PROP_SERIAL_NUMBER:
 		ret = sysfs_emit(buf, "%s\n", value.strval);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/power/supply/power_supply_sysfs.c`**
   - **Removed Function**: The function `power_supply_show_charge_behaviour()` has been completely removed. This function was responsible for retrieving the charge behavior property and formatting it for display.
   - **Updated Logic**: The call to `power_supply_show_charge_behaviour()` in the `power_supply_show_property()` function has been replaced with a direct call to `power_supply_charge_behaviour_show()`, which now uses the `charge_behaviours` from the `psy->desc` and the `value.intval` directly.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The removal of the `power_supply_show_charge_behaviour()` function simplifies the code by eliminating unnecessary complexity and a redundant property read from the driver. 
- The direct call to `power_supply_charge_behaviour_show()` in `power_supply_show_property()` indicates a restructuring of the logic, allowing for a more straightforward and efficient way to display the charge behavior without the intermediary function. This change enhances code clarity and performance by reducing function overhead and potential errors from multiple reads.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
ret = power_supply_get_property(psy,
                POWER_SUPPLY_PROP_CHARGE_BEHAVIOUR,
                value);
```
```c
return power_supply_charge_behaviour_show(dev, psy->desc->charge_behaviours,
                      value->intval, buf);
```
Reason:
The `power_supply_show_charge_behaviour()` function unnecessarily reads the charge behavior property from the driver on each call, which is inefficient and can lead to errors in displaying the charge behavior due to convoluted logic that was a leftover from an earlier patch revision.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
ret = power_supply_charge_behaviour_show(dev, psy->desc->charge_behaviours,
                     value.intval, buf);
```
Reason:
By directly calling `power_supply_charge_behaviour_show()` instead of the convoluted `power_supply_show_charge_behaviour()`, the redundant read of the property is eliminated, simplifying the code and improving efficiency in displaying the charge behavior.
